title: Wearable Microfluidic Diaphragm Pressure Sensor for Health and Tactile Touch Monitoring

extraction_issues.quote: As different applications may require sensing pressure applied over different sized areas, four sensors with diameters of 1.8, 10, 15, and 20 mm
extraction_issues.reason: 此处列表为1.8、10、15和20 mm四种直径，但下一段文字却提及“15, 9, and 1.8 mm sensors were modified”，将10 mm写成了9 mm，前后不一致。

extraction_issues.quote: Both tangential and radial strains are maximum and same at the diaphragm center, given by
extraction_issues.reason: “given by”之后公式本身未被提取，下一页开头是“The tangential strain decreases away from the center…”直接接续，说明原位置的公式在抽取中丢失。

extraction_issues.quote: Figure 1. Microfluidic tactile diaphragm pressure sensor.
extraction_issues.reason: 第3页以“When uniform pressure is applied above the tangential sensing grids, tension around the”结尾，第4页开头接“center causes a decrease…”可通读；但第4页“Both tangential and radial strains are maximum and same at the diaphragm center, given by”后公式缺失，且图注“Figure 1.”位于正文段落之间，可能存在图表插入造成的文本排序异常。

extraction_issues.quote: The liquid PDMS membrane was then cured at 70 °C for 1 h. Another plain PDMS membrane was fabricated in similar ways except that the liquid PDMS was spin coated onto an unpatterned glass slide (Figure S2c,d, Supporting Information).
extraction_issues.reason: 正文中此段多次引用“Figure S2”，但前面第6页实验细节处与正文第3页均提到“Figure S1”是制造流程图；此处引用的S2c,d等可能应为S1中的对应子图；也可能是S1与S2编号约定不同，存疑。

self_check: 已核对摘要、正文与结论中的关键数值：灵敏度0.0835/0.0834 kPa⁻¹、检测限约98 Pa、分辨率低于50 Pa、响应时间90 ms、线性度R²=0.999、温度范围20–50 °C、温度灵敏度漂移0.07% °C⁻¹、最大承受压力0.8 MPa、脉搏75–80→137 bpm、加热功率100/200/300 W、微通道截面70 µm×70 µm、传感器直径20/15/10/1.8 mm、PDMS膜厚约170 µm。摘要中“sub-100 Pa detection limits”（亚100 Pa）与正文98 Pa一致；sub-50 Pa分辨率一致。公式（应变与输出电压关系）原文中明确给出但提取缺失，已在extraction_issues中标注，未自行补写公式内容。直径列表前后不一致（10 vs 9 mm）已标为疑点。
